purpose: Present a state as the utmost degree of an evaluation.
keywords: Staying at a quiet inn is the height of luxury.
After days of work, I was utterly exhausted.
Failing to check is a matter of the deepest regret.
restrictions: Common with 贅沢, 疲労, and 痛恨.
mistake: It is an extreme evaluation, not necessarily a measurable maximum.
